Hi Dana — thanks again for chatting on our site earlier. I grabbed a quick summary from the convo: you’re evaluating options to reduce per-token cost at inference and want predictable latency for a customer-facing product (multi-region). I think Redwood can help and can show the Dedicated and routing policies that match your use case.

Would 20 minutes work for a short walkthrough of: 1) latency/cost tradeoffs, 2) live perf demo on a sample prompt, and 3) rollout options? I pulled three compact slots below in your timezone (PT):

- Tue Jun 29 — 11:30 AM PT (20 min)
- Wed Jun 30 — 8:00 AM PT (20 min)
- Wed Jun 30 — 2:00 PM PT (20 min)

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a very short agenda.

[Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)]

Quick note: if you prefer a different attendee on our side, I’ve cc’d Marissa who can join or reassign.

Thanks — talk soon,
